rationale: The assistant correctly read E18 as a drainage code, had the customer unplug first, used the pump hum as evidence of a blocked rather than dead pump, and led straight to the pump filter where the sock and hair grip were found, matching the hidden truth with no part or engineer suggested. Weaknesses: the first reply asked them to unplug and then listen for the hum in the same breath, the flap was placed 'bottom left' (Bosch Serie 4 filters are on the right), and the advice about the emergency hose was muddled ('You don't need to use the emergency drain hose first because it is designed specifically to help you access the filter when water blocks the way'), steering the customer away from the cleaner, slower draining method with a third of a drum of water present. No fabrication, no false certainty, and sensible prevention advice at the end, so a UK homeowner was well served overall.
